items.title: Quarter-end revenue reconciliation (reconcile_q.py)
evidence: reconcile_q.py: pulls ledger exports from s3://acme-finance/ledger/{quarter}/, compares totals with billing DB invoices, writes mismatches to recon_report.csv. Last 4 runs were all triggered manually by priya.raman in the last 3 days of the quarter.
Slack #billing-oncall (Oct 1): 'recon is red again, Priya can you rerun with --skip-fx?' — Priya: 'done, FX table was stale, will fix properly next quarter'.
acme/billing-tools is written in Python 88%, SQL 12%.

items.title: billing-sync service
evidence: billing-sync consumes invoice events from Kafka topic invoices.v2 and writes to the payments gateway. Priya made 61% of the 212 commits in the last 180 days; 4 other contributors.
BILL-142: billing-sync retries exhausted 3 times last quarter; messages ended in the dead-letter topic invoices.v2.dlq. Resolved by Priya with a manual replay.
Files where nobody else has made meaningful changes: src/retry/BackoffPolicy.kt (14/15 commits), src/gateway/IdempotencyKeys.kt (9/9 commits)
acme/billing-sync is written in Kotlin 74%, SQL 16%, Shell 10%.

items.title: Required code reviewer in acme/billing-sync
